questions.q: What does the law of vibration say, according to the summary?
a: Your emotions influence the reality you attract
Your thoughts fade unless you repeat them daily
Your energy peaks at certain times of day
Your mood is fixed by your childhood
questions.why: Lesson 1 says you cannot just wish for something, you have to feel it.

questions.q: Why does the book say you should spend time in nature?
a: It helps you reach a higher frequency and heal
It burns energy and improves fitness
It replaces the need for meditation
It keeps you away from negative people
questions.why: Lesson 1 recommends self-care in nature and mentions forest bathing as a popular practice.

questions.q: What is the purpose of setting boundaries?
a: To protect your own time and energy, not to hurt others
To punish people who disappoint you
To keep all relationships at a distance
To prove you are independent and strong
questions.why: Lesson 2 says boundaries are about taking care of yourself first, not hurting anyone.

questions.q: What is the first step in setting a boundary?
a: Identify the situations causing you pain or stress
Tell the other person what they must change
End the relationship before it gets worse
Decide how long you can tolerate the problem
questions.why: Lesson 2 lists identifying painful situations as the first of three steps.

questions.q: What does the book mean by planting happy seeds?
a: Replacing limiting beliefs with empowering ones
Writing a gratitude list every morning
Surrounding yourself with optimistic friends
Repeating affirmations before you sleep
questions.why: Lesson 3 says beliefs are seeds, and you weed out limiting ones for empowering ones.
